_measure: style-minus-placebo restoration, activation patching at the final prompt position, 1.5B base model
_power: 20 held-out scenarios x 5 phrasings x 3 dimensions (100 items each) vs 3 placebo pairs x 20 scenarios (60 items); bootstrap CIs, Benjamini-Hochberg across 28 layers
_reporting_rule: A layer is reported only if BH q<0.05 AND |difference| >= 0.03. Layers 20-26 pass significance with effects of 0.005-0.041 because restoration there sits near 1.0 with almost no variance; they are statistically real and practically empty. Do not cite them.
_superseded: An earlier 0.5B run appeared to show a sharp transition at layer 14. It did not replicate at 1.5B and was an artifact of the smaller model. Report the failed replication.

meaningful_negative_region.interpretation: Patching the final position mid-network restores the style effect LESS than it restores the placebo effect. The natural reading is that communication-style information is not concentrated at the final token but remains distributed across the cue tokens, so overwriting one position cannot carry it. Single-position patching therefore understates style. This is a finding about the method's reach as much as about the model.

claim: Style-specific restoration exceeds a length- and embedding-distance-matched irrelevant contrast at layers 3-8 (peak +0.07, BH-corrected, CI excluding zero) and falls markedly below it at layers 10-19. No single site was identified.
do_not_claim: a single localisation site was found
next_method: Residual-stream patching at the cue token positions rather than the final position; or attribution patching, which does not require choosing a position.
